shared_elements: symmetrical frontal composition about a vertical axis
justification: A shows a flat inscribed slab with lines of lettering above a foliate cross with scrolled terminals, purely abstract and epigraphic; B is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a schematic face (drilled eyes, ridge nose, mouth), arms and body, surmounted by a further carved head element. The only shared trait is bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis, which is universal and carries no iconographic weight; there is no common motif, relationship or rendering convention.
